provider_id.description: ID of an existing OpenAI Responses provider configured with a supported HTTPS DashScope base URL
provider_id.hint: The plugin uses the same host's native DashScope synchronous image endpoint and the provider's current key. Leave empty to disable image generation.

allowed_origin.description: Exact unified message origin of the single enrolled WebChat conversation
allowed_origin.hint: Set this to the exact WebChat UMO for the intended administrator conversation. Leave empty to disable the plugin.
